name: _masked_scale
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_masked_scale(Tensor self, Tensor mask, float scale) -> Tensor. Multiplies selected float32 elements by scale and writes zero for unselected elements without mutating or aliasing self or mask. Since the private ATen operator lacks a CPU kernel, tests use an explicit torch.where reference and cover deterministic masks, multiple scales, legacy pointwise and zero-sized shapes, noncontiguous tensors, NaN and infinities, output metadata, and input non-mutation.
